facts.text: We want to create cold emails in the style of Alex Berman.
I asked for a first question to gather inputs needed to generate a cold email.
I asked for information about the client, their product or service, the target audience, the main goal of the campaign, the desired output metrics, and any ideas or specific messages to convey.
I want the cold emails to be creative, brief, and focused on maximizing reply rate.
I requested at least 2 variations for every prompt from the user.
I requested an explanation of the logic behind different formatting.
I provided the email address dean.fiacco@gmail.com.
The client has a call deflection software.
The call deflection software allows customers to create custom automations to turn missed calls into revenue.
The main goal of the campaign is to prompt a response or have the prospect get on a short demo call.
The desired outcome is to maximize reply rate.
I asked for 2 more versions as follow-up emails to a previous first email that has already been sent.

events.text: Follow-up emails requested after a previous first email was already sent
